page.overview:
Who is Clipper?

Clipper hails from Planet Micro, home of the Micromasters. She is obstensibly the "girlfriend" of Holi, though like any girl-kid-character who deals with boy-kid-characters in kid-aimed-anime, she's serious-minded and sometimes bossy and frustrated by the doofiness of her male associates, who she's smarter than to boot.

Clipper was mentioned when the Rescue Patrol Team ridiculed their team leader Holi. Clipper got Holi’s message that he was back but didn’t show up as Holi begged her to introduce the others. Later she was seen with Star Saber and the other micromaster Rescue Patrol team for tea. She was talking to Star Saber and complimenting him.(Holi did not like this) Later Raikru discovered Hellbat, ,Blue Bachus and, Blackshadow. As Holi tried to impress Clipper she told Holi to take it seriously and be careful and eventually Holi’s face completely turned red when Clipper held Holi’s hand. In the end of the battle she told Holi that she’d like him to tell her about Earth. Eventually Holi got humiliated once again.

When Clipper and Holi witnessed the accidental death of the Decepticon Deathcobra at fellow Decepticon Hellbat's hands, Hellbat realized he could blame the pair for Deathcobra's demise. As implausible as this seemed, the rest of Breastforce bought it, securing Hellbat's position as part of their combined form Liokaiser. The giant went after the two Micromasters, only to have Star Saber step in the way.,, Jan imagined Clipper crying in a hankie to tease Holi., A flashback of Liokaiser of Clipper and Holi along with Star Saber., Holi and the Rescue Patrol Team returned to Micro the rescue team was teasing Holi helping Clipper with paperwork.
